correctness.rationale: The radical-square-zero path-power formula gives the exact source-divided-difference and target-offset form for every arrow. Vanishing at all inputs is equivalent to H divisibility for arrow coefficients and sink vertices, H^2 for emitting vertices; H=X^q-X, Hprime=-1. Field Hermite CRT supplies independent data, proving q^{q(v+r+m)} functions. Fiberwise diagonal-affine invertibility is equivalent to vertex permutations and nonzero emitting derivatives, proving (q!)^v(q-1)^{qr}q^{qm} bijections. Explicit F(x)=x^2,G(x)=e_i x give nonclosure on a nonloop arrow; loop-only algebras commute. The exhaustive checker agrees on nine prime-field quivers, but the proof does not rely on finite testing.

value.rationale: The natural task of enumerating right-polynomial functions and permutations on finite J^2=0 algebras is not answered by general two-sidedness results. The completed source/target classification simultaneously treats all finite oriented multiquivers, identifies the emitting-vertex statistic governing the null ideal and function count, and proves an exact commutativity/composition boundary. Both the enumeration and structural obstruction have direct algebraic motivation; neither is a narrow arbitrary finite slice or numerical record.
